en.description: An Informatics Engineering Fresh Graduate from Universitas Pamulang (GPA 3.53) specializing in Data Analysis. Proficient in managing relational databases with SQL and data manipulation via Excel. Skilled in building comprehensive data workflows from Google BigQuery extraction to advanced data processing using Python, and creating interactive visualizations with Power BI to deliver actionable business insights.
I am a lifelong learner, adaptable to new technologies, and ready to contribute as a data-driven professional in the tech industry.
